name: "Feature Request"

title: "[Feature] "
---

# Feature Request

## Problem or Use Case

Describe the problem you are trying to solve.

Explain why the existing ETLRelay functionality is insufficient.

## Proposed Behavior

Describe the capability you would like to introduce.

Focus on observable behavior and requirements rather than implementation details where possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any existing approaches, workarounds, or alternatives you considered.

## Scope and Compatibility

Does this proposal affect any of the following?

- [ ] Public Python API
- [ ] YAML configuration schema
- [ ] CLI behavior
- [ ] Existing source, processor, or sink contracts
- [ ] Dependencies or supported platforms
- [ ] None of the above

Describe the expected impact, if applicable.

## Additional Context

Include examples, references, or other relevant information.

---

**Project Scope**

ETLRelay prioritizes incremental development and small, maintainable abstractions. Proposals may be deferred when there is not yet a demonstrated requirement.

Review the [Roadmap](https://apaquette.github.io/ETLRelay/latest/roadmap/) before proposing significant new functionality.
